events.title: U.S. Dollar Ticks Lower As Investors Monitor Developments In Middle East
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value posted incremental losses on Friday as markets focused on the U.S. call to Iran for discussions to avert a planned intense attack by the U.S. on Iran after November mid-term elections. Iran has not responded until now.

events.title: TSX Drops Nearly 2.5%; Materials, Tech Stocks Down Sharply
events.description: Canadian stocks are down sharply on Friday amid renewed fears about inflation and interest rates following oil prices climbing higher amid supply concerns after a tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Modestly Higher
events.description: The Switzerland market's benchmark SMI ended modestly higher on Friday after holding firm throughout the trading session, outperforming most of its peers in Europe.

events.title: Major European Markets End Mixed As Investors React To Earnings, Economic Data
events.description:
The major European markets closed mixed on Friday even as most of the other markets across the continent ended notably lower, as investors reacted to a slew of corporate earnings announcements and the latest batch of regional economic data.

Higher oil prices and weakness in the tech sector due to renewed uncertainty about returns on AI-related investments hurt sentiment.

events.title: Chicago Business Barometer Pulls Back But Still Indicates Growth In October
events.description: Growth in Chicago-area business activity slowed moderately in the month of October, according to a report released by MNI Indicators on Friday. The report said the Chicago business barometer fell to 55.3 in October after spiking to 58.8 in September, although a reading above 50 still indicates growth. Economists had expected the business barometer to pull back to 56.0.

events.title: Colgate-Palmolive Q3 Results Rise, Lifts FY26 Base Business EPS View; Stock Gains
events.description: Consumer products major Colgate-Palmolive Co., while reporting higher third-quarter results, on Friday confirmed fiscal 2026 outlook for earnings per share. Further, the firm raised guidance for Base Business earnings per share and gross profit margin, while narrowing sales growth view. In pre-market activity on the NYSE, the shares were gaining around 3.34 percent

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open Notably Lower
UK Nationwide House Price Growth Softest Since 2024
events.description: UK house prices grew at the slowest pace since the start of 2024 as rising interest rate expectations weighed on the property market in October, data published by Nationwide Building Society showed Friday. House prices grew only 0.5 percent in October from the previous year. This was weaker than the 0.8 percent rise in September and economists' forecast of 0.6 percent.

events.title: FTSE 100 Modestly Higher; AstraZeneca Rises On Strong Earnings
events.description: U.K. stock market's benchmark FTSE 100 moved higher Friday morning, supported by strong results from pharma major AstraZeneca and energy giant BP. Weakness in bank and mining stocks limited market's upside.

events.title: Indian Shares Extend Gains For Second Day
events.description: Indian shares rose for a second consecutive session on Friday, with information technology stocks leading the surge as disappointing tech earnings fueled a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade globally.

events.title: French Stocks Mixed As Investors React To Earnings, Economic Data
events.description:
French stocks turned in a mixed performance Friday morning with investors reacting to corporate earnings announcements and the latest batch of economic data. 

Data showing an unexpected contraction and higher crude oil prices weighed on sentiment.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower On Interest-rate Concerns
events.description: Gold traded lower on Friday and was on course for a second consecutive monthly loss on concerns over rising crude oil prices and expectations of a Federal Reserve interest-rate rise in December.

events.title: Pound Rises Amid BoE Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday, as traders await the widely anticipated interest rate increase by the Bank of England next week.
